exposure: management strategies for acute myeloid leukemia (AML) during pregnancy
cohort: The study included 17 patients diagnosed with acute myeloid leukemia (AML) during pregnancy, seven of whom had acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL), from January 2012 to June 2019.
finding: A slight delay (less than 14 days) in the termination of pregnancy may not differ the prognosis for non-APL patients, while prompt administration of ATRA is beneficial for highly suspected APL cases.
mod_finding: Five patients underwent cesarean sections, and all newborns (four preterm and one full-term) were alive.
gest_age: Preterm and full-term deliveries were observed.
